text: The old-fashioned way to use varnish involves wiping varnish all over the woodwork, which means your room will be a mess. If you use varnish to fix joints, you should only use it to repair. If you use it to seal up holes in cabinets, windows, or doors, you should seal them with varnish, but if you use varnish to seal up seams, you should wait to finish the work before finishing the varnish.
